name: an2_alt_sum_choose_mul_pow_eq_zero
statement: (n m : ℕ) (h : m < n) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (n.choose k : ℤ) * (k : ℤ) ^ m = 0
closed: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : m < n), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (n.choose k : ℤ) * (k : ℤ) ^ m = 0
informal: The n-th finite difference of a monomial of degree m < n vanishes: sum_k (-1)^k C(n,k) k^m = 0.
type: ∀ (n m : ℕ), m < n → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1) ^ k * ↑(n.choose k) * ↑k ^ m = 0
